verdict.rationale: Docs describe saving plans with `-out=FILE` and applying them via `tofu apply plan.out`, and hands-on probes confirm a full non-interactive plan→apply→destroy loop using `-input=false -auto-approve -detailed-exitcode`, matching the CI approval-flag workflow described in the story. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab CI snippets) showing artifact upload/download between plan and apply stages.
